title: Birth in Mississippi, family from Marshall, Texas
summary: Born July 25, 1905 in Lauderdale County, Mississippi, to a Tex-Pacific railroad family living in Marshall, Texas.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Dick, I was born in Mississippi. Born out in the country from Meridian in 1905. I was living out there. My family was living in Marshall, Texas, where I was actually here. Okay. But I actually was born in Lauderdale County, Mississippi.
July 25, 1905. My mother was such a Mississippian that she just wanted me to be born over here. So, they came over from Texas, so I could be born in Mississippi.
And they had moved over there, I guess?

Yeah, my father was with the Tex-Pacific Railroad, and he had gone over there, and they had been living in Marshall for several years. I have two sisters, Sister Mary and Sister Mary. They were both older than I. And so, I often say I was made in Texas and born in Mississippi.
